children: HealthStream announced a private placement with WJRJJ Ventures, selling 1,355,932 newly issued shares for approximately $40.0 million at $29.50 per share. In a related transaction, the investor acquired 144,068 shares from CEO Robert A. Frist, Jr. for about $4.25 million, totaling 1.5 million shares. The deal closed on Sep 14, 2026, includes a 12-month standstill, and proceeds will fund product investment, working capital, acquisitions, and other strategic initiatives. HealthStream also granted the investor resale registration rights to facilitate future liquidity.
